all_fold_freeze: Every fold I source is fixed before any fold input reaches authoring. Fit/calibration run in mutually isolated automated fold processes; all state seals exist before any held-group R exposure. No shared learned state, warm-start, report, cache or human/agent feedback across folds.
crossed_stimuli: Strict held-stimulus/semantic transfer adds a disjoint canonical stimulus-group split inside the authorized training/calibration/evaluation groups. Repeated presentations and all derived time windows inherit their stimulus group. Unknown cross-source image joins block claims of stimulus novelty, while known held-animal results remain labeled conditional on shared stimuli.
group_sort_ties: SHA256 canonical-ID order, UTF8 canonical-ID lexical tie-break; duplicate canonical ID refers to one group, never two groups.
language: Exactly483 semantic sentence-family identities each encompass all9 languages and every layer. Verified families are sorted by SHA256(canonicalsemanticID UTF8); assign first3 of each consecutive5 totraining, fourthcalibration, fifthheld evaluation (remainders retain their corresponding fixed positions). local_metric: Fit centers/metric using training groups and independent training trial support, select hyperparameters on calibration groups, evaluate assigned held centers/rows/trials. Any required identity missing is unavailable not zero rows. Literal same-sample metric remains R/descriptive, all requested neighborhoods retained.
source_split: Four leave-one-source-out folds using source_split_calibration_map; train on the other2 source names. These are design labels, not inferred animal identities. Untransferable fitted features get unsupported state and raw-target descriptive outcomes; all source branches retained.
units: Simulation world, biological animal/subject and semantic sentence family are distinct independent units. T2/T4, nested subsamples, sessions from one animal, language translations, layers and repeated trials are not additional independent units.
within_source_outer: For each verified animal (Stringer,Majaj,TVSD) or subject(THINGS), hold that entire group out. Sort verified canonical group IDs by SHA256(canonical_ID UTF8); among remaining groups take the next cyclic group as calibration and all others as training. At least3 independent groups required. For fewer3, report the held group and descriptive no-calibration/unsupported split; no invented animal or silent pooled alternate.
